backfill_news.headline: Clean Harbors Safety-Kleen SKSS Segment Delivers 40% Revenue Growth Driven by Oil Pricing
backfill_news.summary: Clean Harbors' Safety-Kleen Sustainability Solutions segment posted greater than 40% top-line growth in Q2 2026, driven by elevated market pricing and effective management of oil collection services. A large manufacturing contract is expected to ramp to an $80 million run rate over 4-5 years.
